project_info.theme: Quán Nhậu Tự Do branch promo at Mega Grand World
project_info.color_palette: White, red, black, warm amber, deep green, food natural tones

main_subject.detail: Vertical branch poster featuring a real nighttime photo of the brightly lit Quán Nhậu Tự Do Mega Grand World building above a lower collage of beer and signature dishes around a central hotpot.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic venue-and-food composite, premium nightlife restaurant promotion

composition_elements.text: CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI MEGA GRAND WORLD
items: Top Left: Red and black headline 'CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI MEGA GRAND WORLD' on white background.
Top Right: Large rounded-corner nighttime venue photo showing the Quán Nhậu Tự Do Mega Grand World facade lit in warm red-orange tones.
Bottom Left: Two beer glasses and plated dishes cut out with white sticker-style outlines.
Bottom Right: Additional meat and vegetable platters around a green tabletop base.
Center/Background: Central hotpot on a portable burner bridging the venue photo and lower food collage.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Mixed night venue and food lighting
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm architectural glow, crisp dish cutout contrast, crowded nightlife ambiance

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Quán Nhậu Tự Do branch promo at Mega Grand World. Centerpiece is a tabletop hotpot surrounded by sticker-cutout dishes and beers, layered below a large real photo of the Mega Grand World branch at night. Background is a clean white header zone above a dark green lower section. Surrounding elements: exact headline 'CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO – MỞ VỊ MỚI TẠI MEGA GRAND WORLD', warm-lit venue facade photo, multiple dish cutouts, and green tabletop base. Technical style: photorealistic composite advertising poster, mixed night venue and food lighting, warm amber glow and crisp cutout edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
